addr: 6th Floor, Garuda Mall, Magrath Rd, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560025, India

rev.t: Very disappointing experience. We came to play laser tag for the 15-minute game that was clearly shown in the advertisement. However, we were asked to wait for 30 minutes because another group behind us wanted to play a 30-minute session …

This was the first time we played SKY Lazer in Garuda mall. It was fantastic. Minimum size is 4 or more so you enjoy. Even suitable for all ages. It's shooting the opposite team Lazer tags to score. Each shooting point you will gain 200 points and you will loose 50 points if opposite team shoots you. Fun and time pass.
It was awesome dawsome fun.!  Not only kids even adults will enjoy fully..! It's a good energetic game too.! Highly highly recommend..!
